scope: recommendation 6 robustness evaluation only; no augmentation training
data: existing validation split only; 600 spectra / 60 positions; no test split read
preprocessing: re-run the existing C pipeline from raw wavelength/intensity for every condition
clean_reproduction_acceptance: each validation C input must match saved X exactly

noise.distribution: zero-mean additive Gaussian in recorded raw intensity units
noise.scale: sigma is the stated fraction of that spectrum's 100-point Gaussian-smoothed background peak
noise.interpretation: dimensionless synthetic stress levels, not instrument SNR; raw intensity unit is unconfirmed
noise.actual_seed_derivation: base_seed + int(level_fraction * 1e6) for each replicate and level

envelope.tilt: I multiplied by exp(sign * log(1+level) * t), t in [-0.5,0.5]; endpoint ratio=(1+level)^sign
envelope.curvature: I multiplied by exp(sign * log(1+level) * (4*t^2 - mean(4*t^2))); edge/center ratio=(1+level)^sign
envelope.intensity: multiply raw intensity, then run the same C pipeline

labels: keep original algorithmic pseudo labels for input-stability comparison; they are not independent truth
metrics: OPD MAE, RMSE, bias, P95 and max absolute error versus pseudo labels
phase circular MAE/RMSE versus pseudo labels and undefined-vector count
prediction drift from each model's clean prediction
selection: no model selection, no checkpoint modification, no training, no calibration, no test-set access
